links.outcome: Whether platforms recognized a rare lymphoma from early and advanced case data
links.effect: Six of eight platforms gave valid differentials; early-stage data mainly yielded infectious diagnoses; at advanced stage only Doctronic and Symptomate explicitly included lymphoma.
links.quote: Early-stage data mainly generated infectious diagnoses like peritonsillar abscess.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and recommendations of eight publicly accessible AI symptom assessment tools on a challenging clinical vignette (ENKTL case) without testing specific deployment safeguards.
